scope: Read-only comparison of comparisonMeasurements and comparisonApp with their tests against /tmp/ear-refine-fixes-20261016/baseline

evidence.detail: Sample positions within two relative machine-epsilon units of an integer are corrected before ceil/floor; positions outside that tolerance remain fractional.
RMS uses corrected start and end without changing its stereo/mono energy convention.
Residual applies the same boundary conversion, retaining source-length clamping and matching-rate validation.
100000 integer frame-to-time-to-frame checks at 8/44.1/48/96/192 kHz pass; 40 genuine fractional boundary checks, including two-billion-frame positions, retain ceil/floor exclusion.
Task snapshots stable id, revision, buffer identity, name, selection and gains instead of retaining mutable track references.
Cancellation tracks source membership/revision/buffer/selection/disposal; residual additionally tracks focus and gains. Presentation, mute, changed marker and RMS-irrelevant changes do not cancel.
RMS final-yield cancellation is checked before committing matching gains.
Residual final-yield cancellation is checked before creating the result dialog; calculations use captured gains.
Errors and cancellation set terminal status only while alive; finally clears busy even for early validation returns.
Independent terminal-state probe verifies insufficient tracks, missing residual focus, silent input, invalid range, changed-selection cancellation and successful RMS completion.

validation.limitations: Values within the explicitly selected floating-point tolerance are intentionally treated as integer boundaries. Tests/probes are deterministic source-level checks rather than real UI timing evidence.
